name: tracking-planner
description: Tracking plans written from evidence, not from memory. Walks your app hands-on, an Android emulator, an iOS simulator, a browser or a Figma file, screenshots every surface, and builds a product-analytics tracking plan from what it actually sees. Every event is graded by evidence, parameters group into reusable attribute packs, sibling events consolidate, and the output is a phased, buildable Excel workbook with the screenshots embedded. GA4 and Firebase first, with destination rules for Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog and Segment.
